title: Systems Engineer
description:
**Business Unit:**
==================

Cubic Transportation Systems

**Company Details:**
====================

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
  
  
We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.

**Job Details:**
================

The Systems Engineer is a qualified, practitioner responsible for applying knowledge and

expertise within the field of systems engineering. This role involves overseeing and

executing interdependent systems engineering activities, including detailed requirements

decomposition, system design, integration, and problem-solving, requiring sophisticated

analytical techniques. The Systems Engineer manages tasks of moderate scope, works

independently on problems of diverse scope, and creates innovative solutions based on

analysis and evaluation of various factors. This position involves significant interaction with

internal and external stakeholders and requires adaptive communication styles for

di erent audiences.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

1. Execute the development, management, and allocation of system requirements to

system elements and subsystems, overseeing the refinement of lower-level requirements

flowed down to other engineering disciplines.

2. Perform complex analyses and trade studies to guide system concept selection,

ensuring system architecture and design align with operational concepts.

3. Create and control systems engineering artifacts such as Requirements Verification

Traceability Matrixes (RVTM), Interface Control Documents (ICD), architecture diagrams,

design documents, system and service workflows, test cases, test plans, test procedures,

and test reports.

4. Devise solutions to a range of complex problems where evaluation of information

requires an in-depth analysis of identifiable factors and creative problem-solving

techniques.

5. Direct and oversee hardware/software integration, system-level integration testing, and

requirement verification, ensuring compliance with established requirements and project

standards.

6. Collaborate with senior stakeholders, internal and external, to communicate technical

concepts, resolve problems, and influence decision-making on technical matters.

7. Prepare technical reports, system documentation, and test plans while ensuring clarity

and compliance with project requirements.

8. Conduct risk management and technical issue resolution activities, providing

innovative and e ective solutions to complex challenges.

9. Mentor and provide guidance to junior engineers, o ering technical expertise and

professional development support.

10. Provide artifacts, data, and technical advice to support proposal e orts.

11. Develop and maintain relationships with stakeholders, ensuring e ective

collaboration and communication to meet project objectives.

General Duties and Responsibilities:

1. Comply with Cubic’s Quality Management System.

2. Comply with Cubic Occupational Health, Safety and Environment policies and

procedures.

3. Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures.

4. Comply with security in accordance with established policies and procedures of

relevant organizations.

Background and Experience:

 Tertiary qualification in the field of system engineering, electrical engineering,

computer science, information systems, or other relevant technical discipline.

 Minimum 5 years of related experience with a Bachelors degree; or 3 years and a

Master’s degree; or a PhD without experience

 Proficiency in preparing Business Requirement Document(BRD), High Level Design

(HLD) and System configuration document. Proficiency in writing and producing

documentation for system specifications, test procedures.

 Experience in performing UAT and Verification & Validation

 Experience in debugging using log management tools like Grey logs, Splunk etc.,

 Basic knowledge on SQL server

 Experience using DOORS requirements traceability tool

 Experience using model-based design methods (SysML or UML) and associate

software applications e.g. Rhapsody.

 Advanced ability using typical PC software such as word processors, databases,

flowcharts, project schedulers, and spreadsheets

 Experience in preparing and presenting information using a variety of media to

various internal and external stakeholders and customers

 Experience using JIRA.

 Experience working in an Agile environment

‎

**Worker Type:**
================

Employee

‎

*We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable law.*

title: Lead / Senior Systems Engineer - HPC Administrator
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Lead / Senior Systems Engineer** specializing in HPC Administration to support and maintain high-performance computing environments, ensuring system reliability, performance, and smooth operational support for end users.

**Responsibilities**

* Triage and resolve HPC systems issues to minimize downtime and performance impact
* Maintain and troubleshoot Linux systems to ensure stability and reliability
* Set up and maintain monitoring systems to track infrastructure health
* Communicate with users and provide operational support for HPC-related inquiries
* Manage and update ServiceNow tickets to track and resolve incidents
* Diagnose, upgrade, and tune HPC hardware components to optimize performance
* Work effectively within environments with minimal documentation

**Requirements**

* 5 to 15 years of overall experience in systems engineering or HPC administration
* Expertise in Linux administration on RPM-based systems
* Proficiency in kernel module compilation and low-level debugging tools such as strace, coredump, and tcpdump
* Skills in monitoring platforms including Zabbix, ELK, and Grafana, with the capability to configure Splunk dashboards
* Background in HPC hardware diagnostics, upgrades, and tuning, including InfiniBand HCAs, Lustre/VAST/IBM storage systems, and Dell/HP servers
* Experience with job schedulers such as Slurm or UGE/AGE

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with cluster management platforms like Bright Cluster Manager, xCAT, or IBM CSM

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)
